refnamediv.refpurpose: Return an element from the cache

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.description;
public mixedCachingIterator::offsetGet stringkey
Returns the element stored under key in the cache. This method is called when the CachingIterator is read with array syntax, such as $iterator['key'].
The CachingIterator::FULL_CACHE flag must be set.
